evidence.description: treesAt obtains Statistics.shared and reads its last-update time and planting totals to calculate the result.

candidates.explanation: TreesProjection directly obtains Statistics.shared to calculate tree counts from planting statistics. This hard-codes access to the statistics service rather than receiving it through an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: TreesProjection declares a globally accessible static shared instance and a public mutable subscriptions array, with no isolation or synchronization.

candidates.explanation: The shared TreesProjection instance exposes mutable subscriptions state without visible actor isolation or synchronization. The immutable shared reference does not protect the mutable instance property.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
